authority.owner: libyijinjing manifest journal plus libkungfu typed fold/fsck
authority.separation: Object qualification evaluates one Episode. Admission remains a destination-owned protocol and separate receipt.

invariants.claim: Every frame-level causal edge in a qualified Episode resolves inside the Episode; external influence is represented by an Episode dependency or declared input reference.
invariants.quantification: all manifest frame attachments and trigger-frame edges in the qualified object
invariants.falsifier: one unresolved internal trigger edge or one undeclared cross-Episode frame edge
invariants.historicalInterpretation: Existing sealed Episodes retain the closure rules of their recorded manifest version.

invariants.claim: Cross-Episode influence is explicit at the Episode dependency or input-reference layer and never inferred from storage locality or timestamp adjacency.
invariants.quantification: all external causal inputs used by the selected Episode projection
invariants.falsifier: a required external input affects the fold without an authoritative dependency or input reference
invariants.historicalInterpretation: Legacy objects are only qualified to the extent their manifest version can represent and verify external inputs.

invariants.claim: A sealed Episode identity binds its exact canonical manifest content and cannot survive a semantic content mutation.
invariants.quantification: one sealed Episode manifest and every root-bearing inventory it declares
invariants.falsifier: changed canonical content with an unchanged sealed identity or accepted root mismatch
invariants.historicalInterpretation: Verbatim migration preserves identity; semantic migration creates a successor object.

invariants.claim: Missing or unverifiable evidence can only remove safe capabilities; repair may restore capabilities after verification and cannot silently grant new authority.
invariants.quantification: the typed qualification result for each lifecycle and evidence state
invariants.falsifier: a capability is marked safe while any declared prerequisite is failed, missing, degraded, or not checked
invariants.historicalInterpretation: Capability policy is interpreted by the exact qualification contract and checker roots recorded in the receipt.

nonClaims: The contract does not make one Episode equal one mmap file.
The contract does not make an admission receipt an object proof.
The contract does not prove replay of external side effects.
The bounded semantic oracle is not a complete formal proof.
